articles.title: Agilent to buy pathology software maker Proscia for $240 million
articles.description: Agilent Technologies has revealed plans to acquire Proscia for $240 million in cash, along with possible performance bonuses. Proscia is known for its innovative digital pathology software, which leverages artificial intelligence to improve the analysis of pathology slides. This strategic acquisition will bolster Agilent's efforts in AI-driven diagnostics and digital pathology.
